public_semantics.discover: A driver exposes the connected device and the operations available on it.
public_semantics.read: A model or program can request observations through simple read operations.
public_semantics.write: A model or program can request device changes through explicit write operations.
public_semantics.reference: Driver metadata can be rendered as device reference material for a model.
public_semantics.limits: Safety limits are enforced by the driver rather than delegated to model text.
